fusions.name: Binding Syllable
fusions.desc: Speaks a turning word into a cone 3.5 tiles long ahead of you that deals 12 damage to everything in it and stuns each one for 1 second.

fusions.name: Closing Verse
fusions.desc: Ends the recitation on a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 18 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at maximum range. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Quickened Patter
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Liturgical Hours
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.
